scenario: 面试官只说了一句“设计一个 ML 系统”，45 分钟内你要展示解决问题的能力。
scenario_en: The interviewer only says, "design an ML system," and you have 45 minutes to show structured problem solving.
q: 为什么要按 framing→data→model→eval→deep dive 顺序推进，而不是先讲模型架构？
q_en: Why follow framing, data, model, evaluation, and deep dives instead of starting with model architecture?
options: 先定业务/ML 目标和数据，模型选择才有依据
顺序不重要，模型细节最能得分
应该跳过数据讨论直接调超参
应该把全部时间留给一个深挖话题
options_en: Nail the objective and data first so model choices are grounded.
Order does not matter; model details earn the most credit.
Skip the data discussion and go straight to tuning hyperparameters.
Spend all your time on a single deep dive.
why: 模型选择依赖数据和目标先确定，倒着讲会让评审觉得你在猜测而不是推导。
why_en: Framing and data must come before modeling because model choices should be derived from the objective, not guessed first.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Frame[Frame] --> Data[Data]
  Data --> Model[Model]
  Model --> Eval[Eval]
  Eval --> DeepDive[Deep dive]
optionMeanings: 把目标和数据放在模型前面讨论
认为讨论顺序无关紧要
跳过数据环节直接调参
把全部时间给单个深挖话题
optionScenarioImpacts: 后续模型选择有理有据，推导链条完整
会让评审觉得设计是拍脑袋的
看不出你如何处理训练数据和标签
framing、数据、模型讨论时间被挤没
optionDirectness: 当目标和数据还没确定时，应先建立推导前提
只有纯模型架构面试才适合把模型细节放在开头
只有数据已明确且题目只考训练细节时，调参才会提前
深挖适合放在主链路讲完、剩余时间聚焦难点时
optionMeanings_en: Discuss the objective and data before model choice.
Treat the order as unimportant.
Skip data and go straight to tuning.
Spend the whole interview on one deep dive.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Model choices have a clear reasoning chain.
The design looks guessed instead of derived.
Training data and labels never get examined.
Framing, data, and model discussion get crowded out.
optionDirectness_en: When objective and data are unclear, establish the premise first.
Model details belong first only in a pure architecture prompt.
Tuning comes early only when the data problem is already fixed.
Deep dives fit after the main design chain is complete.

termDefinitions.meaning: 面试后段针对某个具体技术难点做的深入讨论环节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deep dive is the later interview segment focused on one specific hard part of the design.

scenario: 面试题是“设计电商推荐系统”，没有给候选池规模、展示位置、延迟这些约束。
scenario_en: The prompt is "design an e-commerce recommender," but candidate pool size, placement, and latency are not specified.
q: 开场该先做什么，才不会设计错方向？
q_en: What should you do first so you do not design in the wrong direction?
options: 直接开始画 Transformer 架构图
问清候选池规模、展示位置和延迟要求
只承诺“我们用 Redis 做缓存”
拒绝做任何假设，等面试官喂条件
options_en: Jump straight into drawing a Transformer architecture.
Ask about candidate pool size, placement, and latency requirements.
Commit only to "we'll use Redis for caching."
Refuse to make any assumption and wait to be spoon-fed constraints.
why: 候选池规模和展示位置决定召回和 serving 架构；没澄清就容易设计错问题。
why_en: Targeted clarification questions define the actual ML problem and prevent solving the wrong scope.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官说“你自己假设”，就明确列出假设并继续推进。
tradeoff: 澄清关键约束 vs 假设默认值快速推进
optionMeanings: 跳过约束直接给出架构方案
把规模、位置、延迟三个约束问清楚
把方案过早锁死在单一技术选型上
完全不做任何假设就推进
optionScenarioImpacts: 可能设计出与真实规模不匹配的模型
后续架构选择才有明确依据
没有约束支撑就下结论，显得武断
面试会卡住，没法继续往前推进
optionDirectness: 当约束已经给全时，才适合开始画具体架构
缺候选池、展示位置和延迟时，先澄清这些变量
缓存只适合在读压力或重复请求成为瓶颈后讨论
面试官要求自设假设时，可以声明假设后继续推进
optionMeanings_en: Skip constraints and start with architecture.
Clarify scale, placement, and latency.
Lock the answer onto one technology too early.
Refuse to move without supplied constraints.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The model may not match the real scale.
Later architecture choices have a basis.
The answer sounds premature and unsupported.
The interview stalls instead of progressing.
optionDirectness_en: Architecture comes after the key constraints are known.
Missing pool size, placement, and latency should be clarified first.
Caching matters later when read pressure or repeated requests dominate.
If asked to assume, state assumptions and keep moving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种基于自注意力机制的神经网络架构，常用于序列建模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Transformer is a neural network architecture built on self-attention, commonly used for sequence modeling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存型缓存/键值存储服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store commonly used as a cache.

scenario: 某内容审核系统的 KPI 是“减少违规曝光”，训练时模型只优化一个分类 loss。
scenario_en: A content moderation system's KPI is reducing harmful exposure, but training only optimizes a classification loss.
q: 业务目标和 ML loss 之间是什么关系？
q_en: How should you relate the business objective to the ML loss?
options: 两者永远完全等价
业务目标只写给产品经理看，不影响建模
业务目标是最终价值，ML loss 只是训练用的代理指标
ML loss 的取值不会反过来影响业务结果
options_en: The two are always exactly equivalent.
The business objective is only for product managers and doesn't shape modeling.
The business objective is the real value; ML loss is only a training proxy.
The ML loss value never feeds back into business outcomes.
why: 真实系统优化的是留存、收入或风险，loss 只是训练模型的近似目标。
why_en: The business objective is the real value to optimize, while the ML loss is only a training proxy.
tradeoff: 业务目标（留存/收入/风险） vs ML loss（训练可优化的近似指标）
optionMeanings: 假设两者可以互相替代
把业务目标当成与建模无关的文档
区分最终价值和训练代理
否认 loss 与业务结果之间的因果链
optionScenarioImpacts: 会把 loss 下降误当成业务变好
建模时会失去优化方向
能看穿指标提升但业务变差的陷阱
忽视 loss 设计对业务的实际影响
optionDirectness: 只有目标刚好被 loss 完整表达时，两者才近似等价
业务目标必须进入建模取舍，否则模型会优化错方向
当训练指标只是可优化近似值时，要保留这层区分
loss 会通过模型决策影响业务结果，不能当成无关数值
optionMeanings_en: Assume the two are interchangeable.
Treat the business goal as irrelevant documentation.
Separate final value from the training proxy.
Deny the link between loss and business outcomes.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A lower loss may be mistaken for business success.
Modeling loses its optimization direction.
You can catch metric gains that hurt the business.
You miss how loss design changes product behavior.
optionDirectness_en: They are equivalent only when the loss fully captures the goal.
Business goals must shape modeling tradeoffs.
Keep the distinction when the training metric is only a proxy.
Loss affects model decisions, so it is not isolated from business impact.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来衡量模型预测与目标差距、并据此更新参数的函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A loss function measures how far predictions are from the target and drives parameter updates during training.

scenario: 有害内容系统把“删除内容总量最大化”定为唯一业务目标。
scenario_en: A harmful-content system defines its only business goal as maximizing the total number of removed items.
q: 这个目标设计有什么问题？
q_en: What is wrong with this objective design?
options: 会自动把误删率降到零
会自动提升用户满意度
会让人工审核完全消失
会鼓励过度删除，伤害合法用户和表达自由
options_en: It automatically drives false positives to zero.
It automatically raises user satisfaction.
It makes human review disappear entirely.
It rewards over-removal and harms legitimate users' expression.
why: 只追求删除量会忽略误删成本，和用户表达自由、留存相冲突。
why_en: Maximizing removals alone creates perverse incentives by ignoring false positives and legitimate-user harm.
whenOtherWins: 若内容明确非法且已人工确认，删除量可作为执行指标，而非唯一目标。
tradeoff: 删除量（执行效率） vs 误删代价（合法用户体验）
optionMeanings: 误以为目标越极端误删越少
误以为删除量和满意度天然正相关
误以为该目标能替代人工流程
目标只看删除总量，不看误删代价
optionScenarioImpacts: 实际上误删率可能因此升高
过度删除反而伤害留存和满意度
疑难案例仍然需要人工兜底
会激励系统宁可错删也不放过
optionDirectness: 删除量目标不会自动约束误删，需要单独 guardrail
只有删除准确且用户信任提升时，满意度才可能变好
人工审核是否保留取决于风险等级和置信度
当目标只奖励删除量时，必须把误删代价说出来
optionMeanings_en: Assume a stronger removal goal lowers false positives.
Assume more removals always improve satisfaction.
Assume the objective replaces human review.
See that the objective ignores false-positive cost.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: False positives may actually rise.
Over-removal can hurt retention and trust.
Hard cases still need human fallback.
The system is rewarded for removing too aggressively.
optionDirectness_en: Removal volume does not control false positives by itself.
Satisfaction improves only when removals are accurate and trusted.
Human review depends on risk and confidence, not this metric alone.
When the goal rewards only removals, call out the missing cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把合法内容错误地判成违规并处理掉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is legitimate content that gets wrongly flagged and removed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给主指标设的约束线，防止优化走向极端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail is a constraint metric that stops optimization from swinging to an extreme.

scenario: 业务目标已经定为“提高电商转化率”。
scenario_en: The business goal has been set as improving e-commerce conversion rate.
q: 接下来要把业务目标转化成什么？
q_en: What should you translate the business goal into next?
options: 转成具体建模任务（分类/排序/回归）和技术指标
直接决定最终 UI 文案
锁定云厂商和部署区域
写完所有数据库 SQL
options_en: Translate it into a concrete task (classification/ranking/regression) and technical metrics.
Decide the final UI copy.
Lock in the cloud vendor and deployment region.
Finish writing all the database SQL.
why: ML objective 设定后，数据、模型和评估才有共同方向。
why_en: The ML objective translates the business goal into a concrete modeling task and technical success criteria.
optionMeanings: 把业务目标映射到具体 ML 任务类型
把范围转到产品文案
把范围转到基础设施选型
把范围转到数据库实现细节
optionScenarioImpacts: 数据、模型、评估才有共同方向
不影响后续建模决策
和当前阶段的技术判断无关
跳过了目标到任务的翻译步骤
optionDirectness: 业务目标明确后，应落到任务类型和可评估指标
UI 文案适合在产品体验阶段讨论，不是建模目标
云厂商和区域只在部署约束主导时才提前定
SQL 设计要等数据形态和任务目标明确后再展开
optionMeanings_en: Map the business goal to an ML task type.
Shift the discussion to product copy.
Shift the discussion to infrastructure choice.
Shift the discussion to database implementation.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Data, model, and evaluation share a direction.
It does not guide the modeling choices.
It is unrelated to the current modeling decision.
It skips the goal-to-task translation.
optionDirectness_en: Once the business goal is clear, define task type and metrics.
UI copy belongs in product experience, not the ML objective.
Cloud region matters early only when deployment constraints dominate.
SQL design comes after data shape and task goal are known.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给候选集打分并排出先后顺序的建模任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ranking is a modeling task that scores and orders a set of candidates.

scenario: 推荐系统目标是给用户排出 up-next 视频列表。
scenario_en: The recommender's goal is to produce an ordered up-next video list for each user.
q: ML objective 更适合定义成什么？
q_en: What is the right ML objective for this recommender?
options: 判断用户账号是否存在的二分类
给定用户和上下文，对候选视频排序
压缩视频文件体积
检测数据库死锁
options_en: A binary classifier for whether a user account exists.
Rank candidate videos given the user and session context.
Compress the video file size.
Detect database deadlocks.
why: 推荐的核心输出是有序列表，不是单条绝对判断。
why_en: Video recommendation is primarily a ranking task over candidates given user and session context.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务只问“这条内容是否违规”，二分类目标更合适。
tradeoff: 排序候选集（ranking） vs 单条绝对判断（分类）
optionMeanings: 把目标误定义成账号存在性判断
把目标定义成候选集排序
把目标误定义成压缩任务
把目标误定义成运维监控任务
optionScenarioImpacts: 完全答非所问，没有输出排序
输出正好是一份 up-next 列表
解决的是存储体积问题
解决的是数据库并发问题
optionDirectness: 账号存在性适合身份校验，不产生视频顺序
当输出是一组有序候选时，排序目标更合适
视频压缩适合存储或传输成本问题
死锁检测适合数据库运维，不解决推荐排序
optionMeanings_en: Misdefine the task as account-existence classification.
Define the task as candidate ranking.
Misdefine the task as video compression.
Misdefine the task as database deadlock detection.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It does not produce an ordered list.
It produces the needed up-next list.
It solves a storage-size problem.
It solves a database operations problem.
optionDirectness_en: Account existence fits auth checks, not video ordering.
When the output is ordered candidates, ranking fits.
Compression fits storage or bandwidth cost problems.
Deadlock detection fits database operations, not recommendation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户当前这次访问中的行为和状态信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Session context is the user's behavior and state during the current visit.

scenario: 你要为一个内容审核系统给出高层设计。
scenario_en: You need to present the high-level design for a content moderation system.
q: High-level Design 阶段的目标是什么？
q_en: What is the goal of the high-level design stage?
options: 完整实现每个微服务的代码
深挖所有数据库索引设计
用简单框图/描述对齐输入、组件、输出和动作
跳过讨论直接进入建模
options_en: Fully implement every microservice's code.
Deep-dive into every database index design.
Use a simple block diagram or description to align input, components, output, and action.

why_en: The high-level design aligns the interviewer on inputs, components, outputs, and actions before deeper modeling.

flowchart LR

optionMeanings: 把范围扩大到完整代码实现
把范围扩大到数据库内部细节
用框图对齐系统的输入输出和动作
跳过对齐环节直接进入建模
optionScenarioImpacts: 会占用建模和评估的宝贵时间
偏离了应用型 ML 面试的重点
后续数据、模型讨论有了共同地图
后续讨论失去了共同的系统边界
optionDirectness: 完整代码适合实现轮，不适合高层设计阶段
索引细节只在查询路径是主要瓶颈时展开
高层设计阶段应先对齐输入、组件、输出和动作
建模前缺系统边界时，后续数据和评估会失焦
optionMeanings_en: Expand the scope to full code implementation.
Expand the scope to database internals.
Align the system's inputs, components, outputs, and actions.
Skip alignment and jump into modeling.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It consumes time needed for modeling and evaluation.
It drifts away from the applied ML focus.
Later data and model discussion have a shared map.
Later discussion loses a clear system boundary.
optionDirectness_en: Full code belongs in implementation rounds, not high-level design.
Index details matter only when the query path is the bottleneck.
The high-level stage should align inputs, components, outputs, and actions.
Without system boundaries, modeling and evaluation lose focus.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用方框和箭头简要表示系统组件与数据流向的示意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A block diagram sketches a system's components and data flow using boxes and arrows.

scenario: Applied ML 面试里你想深入讲数据库分片和 API 网关的细节。
scenario_en: In an applied ML interview, you are tempted to spend time on database sharding and API gateway details.
q: 这类 SWE 基础设施细节通常该怎么处理？
q_en: How should you handle these SWE infrastructure details?
options: 把大部分时间都花在数据库分片设计上
完全不讨论系统最终采取的动作
拒绝画出任何组件之间的框图
只在涉及 ML 推理时简要提及

optionMeanings: 把主线换成数据库设计

建模、评估的时间得到保留
optionDirectness: 数据库分片适合基础设施面试，不适合作为应用 ML 主线

组件框图能让面试官快速确认你们在谈同一个系统

optionMeanings_en: Make database design the main thread.

Keep SWE details only where they affect ML.

The interviewer cannot see the end-to-end lifecycle.
The interviewer has a harder time following the design.
Modeling and evaluation time is preserved.
optionDirectness_en: Sharding is central in infrastructure interviews, not applied ML design.
The system action must appear because it determines business effect.
A component diagram keeps both sides aligned on the same system.
SWE details deserve time only when they affect features, inference, or evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据水平拆分到多台数据库实例上以提升容量和吞吐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits data horizontally across multiple database instances to increase capacity and throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一入口，负责路由、鉴权等跨服务的请求处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API gateway is a unified entry point that handles routing, auth, and other cross-service request concerns.

scenario: 你要为电商推荐系统准备训练数据。
scenario_en: You are preparing training data for an e-commerce recommender.
q: Data and Features 部分应该先讨论什么？
q_en: What should the Data and Features section start with?

模型 checkpoint 的命名规则

The naming convention for model checkpoints.

optionMeanings_en: Start with data sources, labels, and quality.
Shift the discussion to UI visuals.
Shift the discussion to engineering naming rules.
Shift the discussion to operations postmortems.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Features and modeling have a reliable foundation.

It only concerns after-incident operations.
optionDirectness_en: The data discussion should first cover sources, labels, bias, and quality.
Button color belongs to product UI, not training data.

Postmortems belong to operations and do not answer the training-data question.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用点击、举报等间接行为代替直接人工标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy label uses an indirect signal like clicks or reports in place of a direct human label.

scenario: 你正在盘点电商推荐系统能用上的训练数据。
scenario_en: You are inventorying training data sources for an e-commerce recommender.
q: 训练数据可以按哪些类别组织？（多选）
q_en: Which buckets can training data be organized into? (Select all that apply.)
options: 监督数据
半监督/代理标签数据
无监督/自监督数据
前端 CSS 类名
options_en: Supervised data
Semi-supervised / proxy-label data
Unsupervised / self-supervised data
Frontend CSS class names
why: 好方案会利用少量高质量标签和大量弱/未标注数据，不同数据桶承担不同角色。
why_en: Training data can be organized into supervised, semi-supervised proxy, and unsupervised or self-supervised sources.

termDefinitions.meaning: 利用数据自身结构生成监督信号，无需人工标注。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-supervised learning derives its own training signal from the structure of the data without human labels.

scenario: features 阶段你已经想到 50 个候选字段。
scenario_en: During the feature discussion, you have thought of 50 possible fields.
q: 更好的表达方式是什么？
q_en: What is the better way to present the feature discussion?
options: 逐字读完全部 50 个字段
挑高价值信号来源，说明假设和表示方式
只说“字段越多越好”
完全不谈任何编码方式
options_en: Read out all 50 fields one by one.
Pick high-value signal sources and explain the hypothesis and representation.
Just say "more fields is always better."
Never discuss how any of it is encoded.
why: 面试官看的是你如何判断信号价值和落地成本，而不是字段数量。
why_en: A feature discussion should prioritize high-value signal sources and representation choices instead of dumping every possible field.
whenOtherWins: 若面试官明确要求先 brainstorm 全部字段，可以先发散再收敛。
tradeoff: 少量高价值信号 + 假设 vs 穷举字段列表
optionMeanings: 把每个字段平等地念一遍
先筛选再解释信号价值
用一句口号代替判断力
只谈信号不谈如何表示
optionScenarioImpacts: 占用时间但没有信号增量
面试官能看到你的取舍逻辑
面试官看不出优先级判断
模型拿不到可用的输入格式
optionDirectness: 逐项朗读适合穷举记录，不适合有限面试时间
字段很多时，应筛出高价值信号并解释假设
只有已验证字段都有效时，更多字段才可能更好
编码方式决定模型能否使用这些信号，不能省略
optionMeanings_en: Read every field with equal weight.
Filter for high-value signals and explain why.
Replace judgment with a slogan.
Discuss signals without representation.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It takes time without adding insight.
The interviewer sees your prioritization logic.
The interviewer cannot see your judgment.
The model has no usable input format.
optionDirectness_en: Reading fields one by one fits an inventory, not a timed interview.
With many fields, pick high-value signals and explain the hypothesis.
More fields help only when the fields are validated as useful.
Encoding determines whether the model can use the signals.

scenario: 你已经列出类别、文本、图片、数值等候选特征。
scenario_en: You have listed candidate features such as categories, text, images, and numeric values.
q: 除了列出信号，还必须说明什么？
q_en: Beyond listing signals, what else must you explain?
options: 只说明变量名称
只说存进哪张数据库表
每种信号如何编码/表示给模型使用
只关心训练速度
options_en: Just the variable names.
Just which database table it lives in.
How each signal is encoded or represented for the model.
Just how fast training runs.
why: 类别、文本、图片、数值的表示方式不同，高级回答会说明编码选择。
why_en: Feature discussion must include how each signal is represented for the model.
optionMeanings: 只停留在命名层面
只停留在存储层面
说明每种数据类型的编码方式
只停留在训练效率层面
optionScenarioImpacts: 模型无法直接使用变量名
存储位置不影响模型能否使用它
模型才能真正吃进这些特征
跳过了模型能否理解输入的问题
optionDirectness: 变量名只能帮助沟通，不能直接变成模型输入
数据库位置适合数据工程讨论，不等于特征表示
每类信号进入模型前都需要明确编码方式
训练速度要在可用表示确定后再优化
optionMeanings_en: Stay at the variable-name level.
Stay at the storage-location level.
Explain how each data type is encoded.
Focus only on training speed.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The model cannot use variable names directly.
Storage location does not make a feature trainable.
The model can actually consume the features.
It skips whether the model understands the input.
optionDirectness_en: Variable names help communication, but they are not model inputs.
Database location is data engineering, not feature representation.
Every signal type needs an encoding before it reaches the model.
Training speed should be optimized after a usable representation exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把类别或文本等离散信号映射成稠密向量的表示方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding maps a discrete signal such as a category or text into a dense vector representation.

scenario: 你要给推荐系统的排序模型选出第一个可运行版本。
scenario_en: You need to choose the first runnable ranking model for a recommender.
q: 为什么要先讲 benchmark/baseline？
q_en: Why should you discuss a benchmark or baseline first?
options: baseline 一定会最终上线
baseline 不需要任何数据
有了 baseline 就可以跳过评估
给复杂模型一把尺子，证明额外复杂度值得
options_en: The baseline will always ship to production.
A baseline needs no data at all.
Once you have a baseline you can skip evaluation.
It gives complex models a yardstick that justifies the extra complexity.
why: 简单 baseline 快、可解释，能判断复杂模型是否值得。
why_en: A baseline grounds the modeling discussion and gives a yardstick for justifying additional complexity.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Baseline[Simple baseline] --> Compare[Measure lift]
  Compare --> Complex[Complex model]
  Complex --> Justify[Justify cost]
optionMeanings: 误以为 baseline 就是最终方案
误以为 baseline 可以脱离数据存在
误以为有了参照就不用评估
用简单模型当比较基准
optionScenarioImpacts: 会让讨论失去循序渐进的结构
无法真正衡量任何模型的效果
复杂模型的收益无法被验证
每次加复杂度都有据可依
optionDirectness: baseline 可以上线，但更常用来建立比较地板线
无数据时只能做启发式规则，不能训练有效 baseline
baseline 仍然需要评估，才能证明复杂模型有增益
复杂模型要先赢过简单参照，额外成本才有理由
optionMeanings_en: Assume the baseline must ship.
Assume a baseline needs no data.
Assume the baseline removes the need for evaluation.
Use a simple model as the comparison yardstick.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The discussion loses its step-by-step structure.
No model quality can be measured.
The complex model's gain cannot be validated.
Every added complexity has evidence behind it.
optionDirectness_en: A baseline may ship, but it usually establishes a floor.
Without data, you only have heuristics, not a trained baseline.
A baseline still needs evaluation to prove later gains.
A complex model must beat the simple reference to justify its cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用来比较后续复杂方案收益的简单参照模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A baseline is a simple reference model used to measure the gain from a more complex approach.

scenario: 欺诈检测第一版有结构化数值和类别特征，延迟敏感。
scenario_en: The first fraud detection version has structured numeric and categorical features and is latency-sensitive.
q: 合理的 baseline 是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable baseline model?
options: 轻量表格模型：LR 或 GBDT
参数量最大的多模态 LLM
对候选做纯随机排序打分
人工为每个用户手写规则
options_en: A lightweight tabular model: logistic regression or GBDT.
The largest multimodal LLM available.
Score candidates with pure random ordering.
Hand-write rules for every single user.
why: 结构化 tabular 特征上，轻量模型快且有竞争力。
why_en: For structured low-latency fraud features, logistic regression or GBDT is a practical baseline.
whenOtherWins: 若输入主要是长文本或图像语义，预训练 encoder 会更有优势。
tradeoff: 轻量表格模型快速迭代 vs 大模型的语义能力
optionMeanings: 用轻量表格模型做起点
用最大规模模型做起点
用无信号方法做起点
用人工规则做起点
optionScenarioImpacts: 训练快、延迟低，正好匹配约束
训练和 serving 成本远超延迟预算
完全没有区分能力，不是基线
扩展性差，覆盖不了长尾用户
optionDirectness: 结构化特征且延迟敏感时，LR/GBDT 是低成本起点
大模型适合语义输入足够强且预算充足的场景
随机排序只适合 sanity check，不能衡量可学习信号
人工规则适合少量明确模式，不适合覆盖长尾用户
optionMeanings_en: Start with a lightweight tabular model.
Start with the largest model available.
Start with a no-signal method.
Start with manual per-user rules.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Training is fast and latency stays low.
Training and serving cost exceed the budget.
There is no real ranking signal.
Maintenance does not scale to long-tail users.
optionDirectness_en: For structured, latency-sensitive features, LR or GBDT is a cheap starting point.
Large models fit when semantic inputs and budget are strong enough.
Random ranking is only a sanity check, not a learnable baseline.
Manual rules fit a few clear patterns, not long-tail coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 梯度提升决策树，一种在表格数据上常用且训练快的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT, gradient boosted decision trees, is a model family that trains quickly and works well on tabular data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种输出概率的线性分类模型，可解释性强。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logistic regression is a linear classifier that outputs probabilities and is easy to interpret.

scenario: 你要在结构化特征上比较“经典模型”和“深度学习模型”两条路线。
scenario_en: You need to compare classic models and deep learning models on structured features.
q: Model Selection 讨论应该覆盖哪些维度？
q_en: Which dimensions should the model selection discussion cover?
options: 只报出最新一篇论文的名字
比较模型家族的质量成本延迟权衡
只说一句用深度学习就行
只讨论数据库该选哪种类型
options_en: Just name-drop the newest paper you read.
Compare model families on quality, cost, and latency trade-offs.
Just say "use deep learning" and stop there.
Just discuss which database to pick.
why: 面试官要看你能在约束下选模型，而不是盲目追求复杂。
why_en: Model selection should compare families on quality, cost, latency, interpretability, and operational complexity.
tradeoff: 质量/复杂度 vs 成本/延迟/可解释性
optionMeanings: 把选型简化成追新
系统比较模型家族的多个维度
把选型简化成一句口号
把讨论转移到存储层
optionScenarioImpacts: 不能证明方案适配约束
能说明为什么选某一家族而非另一个
没有给出可验证的取舍依据
偏离了模型选择这个问题本身
optionDirectness: 新论文只在约束和数据形态匹配时才有说服力
模型选型应按质量、成本、延迟和可解释性比较
深度学习可作为候选，但需要说明为什么值得
数据库选择只在服务路径约束模型形态时才相关
optionMeanings_en: Reduce selection to name-dropping a new paper.
Compare model families across real tradeoff dimensions.
Reduce selection to a slogan.
Move the discussion to storage.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It does not prove fit to the constraints.
It explains why one family beats another here.
It gives no verifiable tradeoff reasoning.
It leaves the model-selection question unanswered.
optionDirectness_en: A new paper helps only when it matches the constraints and data shape.
Model selection should compare quality, cost, latency, and interpretability.
Deep learning can be a candidate, but it needs justification.
Database choice matters only if the serving path constrains model shape.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户塔和物品塔分别编码，再计算相似度的推荐模型架构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model encodes users and items in separate towers and scores them by similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量空间快速查找最相似候选的近似算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, approximate nearest neighbor search, quickly finds the most similar candidates in vector space.

scenario: 你直接提出训练一个超大模型，但数据少、延迟预算紧。
scenario_en: You propose training a very large model, but data is limited and the latency budget is tight.
q: 面试官最可能担心什么？
q_en: What is the interviewer most likely worried about?
options: 模型太可解释
baseline 太强，没必要建模
过拟合、训练/serving 成本不可行
标签成本太低
options_en: The model is too interpretable.
The baseline is too strong to bother modeling.
Overfitting and infeasible training/serving cost.
Labels are too cheap to obtain.
why: 复杂模型必须用数据量、质量收益和推理预算支撑，否则显得没有生产经验。
why_en: A large model needs justification through data scale, quality gain, and serving budget.
tradeoff: 模型容量/质量上限 vs 数据量、训练成本、serving 可行性
optionMeanings: 把可解释性错当成一个风险
把基线强度错当成拒绝理由
指出容量与数据/预算不匹配的风险
把标签成本低错当成问题
optionScenarioImpacts: 可解释性从不是这里的风险来源
baseline 强弱和当前风险无关
点出这套方案在当前约束下不可行
标签成本高低不是本题焦点
optionDirectness: 可解释性高通常降低排查成本，不是这里的主要风险
baseline 强只说明门槛高，不解释大模型为何危险
数据少且延迟紧时，大模型最容易卡在泛化和 serving 上
标签成本低通常是优势，且场景没有给这个约束
optionMeanings_en: Mistake interpretability for the risk.
Mistake baseline strength for the concern.
Point to capacity, data, and budget mismatch.
Mistake cheap labels for a problem.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Interpretability is not the source of risk here.
Baseline strength does not explain the current risk.
The proposed model is not feasible under the constraints.
Label cost is not the focus of this prompt.
optionDirectness_en: High interpretability usually lowers debugging cost here.
A strong baseline raises the bar but does not explain large-model risk.
With little data and tight latency, large models strain generalization and serving.
Cheap labels are usually helpful, and the prompt does not mention them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型记住训练数据细节，泛化到新数据时表现变差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overfitting is when a model memorizes training data details and generalizes poorly to new data.

scenario: 你提出一个双塔排序模型，面试官追问架构细节。
scenario_en: You propose a two-tower ranking model, and the interviewer asks for architecture details.
q: “穿针引线”式回答架构细节是什么意思？
q_en: What does a balanced architecture-detail answer look like?
options: 直接断言“4 层 1024 维一定最优”
完全跳过 loss 设计不谈
只画云基础设施部署架构图
给出输入、层结构、loss、正则，但不编精确超参
options_en: Flatly claim "4 layers of 1024 is always optimal."
Skip explaining the loss design entirely.
Only draw the cloud deployment infrastructure diagram.
Describe the input, layers, loss, and regularization without inventing exact hyperparameters.
why: 要说明结构关键点，但不假装已知只有实验能定的精确宽度。
why_en: Architecture discussion should be detailed enough to show understanding without pretending empirical hyperparameters are known.
optionMeanings: 把未经验证的超参说成必然最优
跳过 loss 这个关键设计点
把讨论换成基础设施图
给结构细节但承认超参需要实验
optionScenarioImpacts: 会被追问细节时露出破绽
面试官无法判断你是否懂模型
答非所问，没有回应架构问题
既显示理解又保持诚实
optionDirectness: 精确层数和维度需要实验验证，不能提前断言最优
loss 连接训练目标和模型行为，架构回答里要交代
云部署图适合 serving 讨论，不回答模型内部结构
被追问架构时，应讲关键结构并承认超参需实验
optionMeanings_en: Claim untested hyperparameters are optimal.
Skip the loss design.
Switch the topic to cloud infrastructure.
Give structure details without inventing exact hyperparameters.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The claim breaks under follow-up questions.
The interviewer cannot tell if you understand the model.
It does not answer the architecture question.
It shows understanding while staying honest.
optionDirectness_en: Exact layers and widths need experiments, not early certainty.
Loss connects the training goal to behavior, so include it.
Cloud diagrams fit serving discussions, not model internals.
When asked for architecture, cover key structure and flag hyperparameters as empirical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制模型复杂度以降低过拟合风险的技术，如 dropout、L2。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Regularization limits model complexity to reduce overfitting risk, such as dropout or an L2 penalty.

scenario: 模型训练完成，你要说明如何上线和评估它。
scenario_en: The model is trained, and you need to explain how to serve and evaluate it.
q: Inference and Evaluation 阶段要覆盖哪两类内容？
q_en: What two kinds of topics should inference and evaluation cover?
options: 离线/在线指标，加延迟成本扩展约束
只反复检查训练阶段的代码
只讨论候选人的简历背景
只关心前端界面的视觉设计
options_en: Offline/online metrics plus latency, cost, and scale constraints.
Only re-check the training-stage code.
Only discuss the candidate's resume background.
Only care about frontend visual design.
why: 应用 ML 成功不仅看模型分数，还要能在 SLA 内服务并改善业务。
why_en: Inference and evaluation cover both metrics and the practical serving constraints such as latency, cost, and scale.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Offline[Offline metrics] --> Gate[Launch gate]
  Online[Online metrics] --> Gate
  Serving[Latency cost scale] --> Gate
  Gate --> Iterate[Iterate]
optionMeanings: 同时覆盖评估指标和推理约束
只关心训练阶段的代码
把话题转到无关的招聘环节
把话题转到界面设计
optionScenarioImpacts: 能判断模型是否真的可以上线
看不出模型能否满足 SLA
候选人简历和上线评估无关
界面视觉和上线评估无关
optionDirectness: 上线前要同时看指标效果和 serving 约束
训练代码检查适合研发流程，不等于上线评估
简历背景和模型是否可上线无关
前端视觉只在实验目标涉及 UI 时才相关
optionMeanings_en: Cover metrics and serving constraints together.
Only inspect training code again.
Move to an unrelated hiring topic.
Move to frontend visual design.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: You can decide whether the model is launchable.
You cannot tell whether serving meets the SLA.
The resume has no bearing on launch evaluation.
Visual design is unrelated to launch evaluation.
optionDirectness_en: Before launch, check both metric impact and serving constraints.
Training-code review is an engineering process, not launch evaluation.
Resume background is unrelated to whether the model can ship.
Frontend visuals matter only when the experiment target involves UI.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过 A/B 实验衡量模型对真实用户业务指标的影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online evaluation measures a model's real impact on business metrics through an A/B experiment.

scenario: 推荐模型离线 NDCG 提升了，但线上用户留存下降。

离线 ML 指标和业务目标没有完全对齐
留存下降不重要，可以忽略
模型完全不需要调整

The offline ML metric and the business objective are not fully aligned.

optionMeanings: 把结果归咎于计算错误
把两个指标的错位当成信号
把业务信号当成可忽略项
认为当前结果不需要任何行动
optionScenarioImpacts: 掩盖了指标错位这个真正问题
会推动你回去检查目标设计
会让业务持续受损而不自知
错过了修正模型或指标的机会
optionDirectness: 只有复现发现公式或日志有误时，才先归因计算错误
离线指标上涨但业务下跌时，应怀疑目标未对齐
留存是业务目标信号，不能因离线分数好就忽略
指标互相矛盾时，至少要切片分析或调整目标
optionMeanings_en: Blame the result on a metric bug.
Treat the metric mismatch as the signal.
Ignore the business signal.
Assume no model change is needed.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It hides the real alignment problem.
It pushes you to inspect the objective design.
The business can keep getting worse.
You miss a chance to fix the model or metric.
optionDirectness_en: Blame calculation only after reproduction shows a formula or logging bug.
When offline goes up and business goes down, suspect objective mismatch.
Retention is a business signal and cannot be ignored for a better offline score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量、并对靠后位置做折扣的离线指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is an offline ranking metric that discounts the value of correct results appearing lower in the list.

scenario: 推理阶段的延迟和成本约束很紧，你要挑选优化手段。
scenario_en: Inference latency and cost constraints are tight, and you need to choose optimization techniques.
q: 推理约束紧时可以讨论哪些优化？（多选）
q_en: Which optimizations are worth discussing when inference constraints are tight? (Select all that apply.)
options: 缓存
量化
蒸馏
剪枝
options_en: Caching
Quantization
Distillation
Pruning
why: 这些方法用不同方式降低成本或延迟，但都要以质量回归监控为前提。
why_en: Caching, quantization, distillation, and pruning are common inference optimizations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重用更低精度表示以降低计算和内存开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization represents model weights with lower precision to cut compute and memory cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个大模型（teacher）的输出训练一个更小的模型（student）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model's outputs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除模型中冗余的权重或连接以减少计算量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning removes redundant weights or connections from a model to reduce computation.

scenario: 你想给一个低 QPS 的离线批处理任务做复杂量化和蒸馏。
scenario_en: You want to apply complex quantization and distillation to a low-QPS offline batch job.
q: 面试里更合理的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the more reasonable tradeoff in the interview?
options: 默认所有模型都必须量化
直接忽略质量回归评估
先确认是否真受推理成本或延迟约束
把批处理硬改成实时服务
options_en: Assume every model must be quantized by default.
Skip quality-regression evaluation entirely.
Confirm whether cost or latency is actually the constraint.
Force the batch job into a real-time service.
why: 优化应服务约束，离线低频任务可能更该保质量和可维护性。
why_en: Inference optimizations should be justified by actual latency, cost, or throughput constraints.
whenOtherWins: 若批处理成本巨大或时间窗口很短，量化/蒸馏仍然值得做。
tradeoff: 推理优化收益 vs 额外复杂度和维护成本
optionMeanings: 把优化当成不看约束的默认动作
把优化的质量代价视而不见
先验证约束是否存在再决定优化
把架构形态和约束需求搞反
optionScenarioImpacts: 低 QPS 场景白白付出维护成本
可能悄悄引入质量回归
避免为不存在的约束增加复杂度
实时化和场景本身的批处理性质冲突
optionDirectness: 量化适合成本或延迟真是瓶颈的模型
任何有损优化上线前都要检查质量回归
低 QPS 离线任务应先确认优化收益是否大于复杂度
实时化只在产品需要低延迟响应时才成立
optionMeanings_en: Make optimization the default action.
Ignore the quality cost of optimization.
Check whether the constraint actually exists.
Force the architecture into a real-time shape.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The low-QPS job pays needless maintenance cost.
A quality regression can slip in silently.
You avoid complexity for a nonexistent constraint.
The design conflicts with the batch nature of the task.
optionDirectness_en: Quantization fits when cost or latency is truly the bottleneck.
Any lossy optimization needs quality-regression checks before launch.
For low-QPS batch jobs, verify the benefit beats the complexity.
Real-time serving only fits when the product needs low-latency responses.

scenario: 设计进入 Deep Dives 阶段，系统里有冷启动、反馈循环、扩展性等潜在难点。
scenario_en: The design reaches deep dives, and the system has hard parts such as cold start, feedback loops, and scaling.
q: 这一阶段该如何选择要讲的内容？
q_en: How should you choose what to cover in this stage?
options: 不管问题是什么都讲自己最熟的强化学习
退回问题澄清阶段重新开始
回避承认设计里任何潜在风险
跟随面试官，或主动列出系统真正的技术难点供选择
options_en: Talk about your favorite reinforcement-learning topic regardless of fit.
Go back and restart the problem-clarification stage.
Avoid admitting any potential risk in the design.
Follow the interviewer, or proactively list the design's real hard parts to choose from.
why: 深挖用于展示特定领域深度，要聚焦系统真正的技术难点。
why_en: Deep dives should focus on the most relevant hard parts, either interviewer-driven or clearly offered as options.
optionMeanings: 把话题硬拉回自己偏好的领域
把已完成的阶段重新推倒
对设计里的风险避而不谈
把难点列成菜单交给面试官选
optionScenarioImpacts: 可能完全偏离这道题的核心难点
浪费本该用于深挖的剩余时间
让面试官怀疑你没意识到风险
深挖内容始终贴合这个系统
optionDirectness: 熟悉话题只有贴合本系统难点时才值得展开
澄清已完成后，应把时间用于具体难点
承认风险并给缓解方案，比回避风险更有说服力
深挖阶段适合围绕冷启动、反馈循环或扩展性展开
optionMeanings_en: Drag the discussion to your favorite area.
Restart the already-finished framing stage.
Avoid naming risks in the design.
Offer the system's real hard parts as a menu.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The topic may miss the system's core difficulty.
It wastes the remaining deep-dive time.
The interviewer may think you missed the risks.
The deep dive stays tied to this system.
optionDirectness_en: A familiar topic is worth time only if it fits this system.
After framing is done, spend time on concrete hard parts.
Naming risks and mitigations is stronger than hiding them.
Deep dives fit cold start, feedback loops, or scaling in this prompt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品缺乏历史数据，模型难以给出可靠预测的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is the problem of making reliable predictions for new users or items that lack historical data.

scenario: 你在为一个推荐系统列出可深挖的方向。
scenario_en: You are listing possible deep-dive areas for a recommender system.
q: 常见 deep dive 主题包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are common deep-dive topics? (Select all that apply.)
options: 冷启动/边界案例
规模与 serving
监控和重训
无关 UI 动画
options_en: Cold start and edge cases
Scaling and serving
Monitoring and retraining
Unrelated UI animations
why: 这些主题直接影响生产可用性和长期质量。
why_en: Common ML design deep dives include cold start, scaling, monitoring, and retraining.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  DeepDive[Deep dive menu] --> Cold[Cold start]
  DeepDive --> Scale[Serving scale]
  DeepDive --> Monitor[Monitor retrain]

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上数据分布随时间变化，导致模型效果衰减。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model drift is when the live data distribution shifts over time and model performance decays.

scenario: 面试官给你一个模糊的系统设计问题，你正要开场。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives you a vague system design prompt, and you are about to start.
q: Problem Framing 阶段的绿旗包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are green flags in the problem framing stage? (Select all that apply.)
options: 问到核心约束
建立清晰业务目标
给出可指导后续设计的 ML objective
跳过目标直接报模型
options_en: Asking about the core constraints
Establishing a clear business objective
Giving an ML objective that guides the rest of the design
Skipping the objective and jumping straight to a model
why: 开场要让后续所有选择有依据，跳过目标会暴露约束没对齐。
why_en: Good problem framing clarifies constraints, business objective, and ML objective before modeling.

scenario: 你在评估一段 Modeling 阶段的面试表现。
scenario_en: You are evaluating someone's performance in the modeling stage of an interview.
q: Modeling 阶段的红旗包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are red flags in the modeling stage? (Select all that apply.)
options: 不考虑 baseline 直接上复杂模型
模型架构完全手挥
不讨论 tradeoff
说明简单基线的作用
options_en: Jumping to a complex model without considering a baseline
Hand-waving the model architecture entirely
Never discussing trade-offs
Explaining what the simple baseline is for
why: 模型讨论要体现实践取舍和理解深度，baseline 本身不是红旗。
why_en: Modeling red flags include skipping baselines, hand-waving architecture, and ignoring tradeoffs.

q: 按推荐顺序排列 ML system design delivery framework。
q_en: Put the ML system design delivery framework in the recommended order.
why: 这个顺序先定义问题边界，再讨论数据、模型、上线评估，最后深挖，保证关键评估点都被覆盖。
why_en: The delivery framework moves from framing to high-level design, data, modeling, inference and evaluation, then deep dives.
tradeoff: 覆盖全部关键阶段 vs 在某一阶段停留过久

termDefinitions.meaning: 针对某个具体技术难点进行更细致讨论的阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deep dive is a focused, detailed discussion of one specific hard part of the design.

q: 按正确顺序完成 Problem Framing。
q_en: Put the problem framing steps in the correct order.
why: 先知道问题边界，再定义业务价值，最后把它转成可建模任务。
why_en: Problem framing clarifies scope, establishes the business objective, and then defines the ML objective.
tradeoff: 先约束后目标 vs 先目标后约束

q: 按合理顺序展开 Modeling 讨论。
q_en: Put the modeling discussion steps in a reasonable order.
why: 先建立地板线，再讲选择空间，之后深入并证明复杂度的价值。
why_en: A modeling discussion should start with baselines, compare options, then deep dive and justify complexity.
tradeoff: 先简后繁证明复杂度 vs 一上来就上复杂模型
steps: 比较候选模型家族和 tradeoff
选一个方案深入架构、loss、正则
说明为什么复杂度值得

termDefinitions.meaning: 用来比较后续复杂方案收益的简单参照模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A baseline is a simple reference model used to measure the gain from a more complex approach.

scenario: 你想把业务目标映射到评估指标。
scenario_en: You want to map a business objective into evaluation metrics.
q: 这段伪代码表达了什么思路？
q_en: What idea does this pseudocode express?
codeSample:
business_objective = "reduce harmful views"
product_metric = views_of_harmful_content
ml_metric = recall_at_precision(0.95)
options: 从业务目标逐层派生产品指标和 ML 指标
把 ML loss 当业务目标
只优化 accuracy
跳过 guardrail
options_en: Derive the product metric and ML metric from the business objective, layer by layer.
Treat the ML loss as the business objective.
Optimize accuracy alone.
Skip the guardrail entirely.
why: 业务目标是减少有害曝光，ML 指标要服从误删 precision guardrail。
why_en: The pseudocode maps a business objective into a product metric and an ML metric with a precision guardrail.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务目标是纯离线研究，产品指标层可能不明显，但仍要说明最终价值。
tradeoff: 从业务目标逐层派生指标 vs 直接把 ML loss 当业务目标
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Biz[Business goal] --> Product[Product metric]
  Product --> ML[ML metric]
  ML --> Guardrail[Guardrail]
  Guardrail --> Decision[Launch decision]
optionMeanings: 把业务目标拆成产品层再拆成 ML 层
把训练用的近似目标误当成业务目标
只盯单一指标而忽略约束
丢掉防止误删过多的约束
optionScenarioImpacts: 上线决策能一路追溯回业务价值
会把手段误当成目的
召回提升但可能误删激增
recall 提升的代价可能失控
optionDirectness: 代码从业务目标到产品指标再到 ML 指标逐层收敛
只有没有业务层目标时，ML loss 才会被误当成终点
accuracy 适合类别均衡且错误代价接近的任务
有误删风险时，precision 门槛必须保留
optionMeanings_en: Break the goal into product and ML layers.
Mistake the training proxy for the business goal.
Watch one metric and ignore constraints.
Drop the constraint that limits over-removal.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Launch decisions trace back to business value.
The method gets mistaken for the end goal.
Recall may rise while false positives explode.
The cost of higher recall can run away.
optionDirectness_en: The code narrows from business goal to product metric to ML metric.
ML loss becomes the endpoint only when the business layer is missing.
Accuracy fits balanced classes with similar error costs.
When false positives matter, keep the precision threshold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在满足某个精确率门槛的前提下能达到的最高召回率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall at precision is the highest recall achievable while meeting a minimum precision threshold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给召回类指标设置的最低精确率约束，防止误删过多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A precision guardrail is a minimum-precision constraint placed on a recall-style metric to prevent excessive false positives.
